CoffeePowderPerRegularCoffee.definition: Amount of coffee powder required to produce one regular coffee

MilkPerRegularCoffee.definition: Amount of milk required to produce one regular coffee

TimePerRegularCoffee.definition: Time taken to produce one regular coffee

MochaToRegularRatio.definition: Minimum multiple of mochas required compared to regular coffees
